2390-3966-5875.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-3966-5875.description:
Gain life.
Essence Channeler triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

643-2034-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-2034-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the artifact creature, adding {C}{C}
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

4490-7816--210.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4490-7816--210.description:
Give Shalai and Hallar lifelink, if needed.
Gain life.
Titanbones triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing damage to an opponent and causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 3.
4490-7816--210.notes: Additional mana and/or prerequisites may be required depending on the method used to give Shalai and Hallar lifelink.

5686-8168.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token with flying due to Draconic Visitor.
Repeat.

5254-6797-7741.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
5254-6797-7741.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

238-3899-5756.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Gerrard.
When Gerrard dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning up to one legendary creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Havi.
When Havi dies, it triggers, returning Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gerrard trigger from step 2, failing to exile it as it is no longer in your graveyard and returning Havi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.

618-4247-6966.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of All-Fates Stalker.
When the All-Fates Stalker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the All-Fates Stalker token.
When the All-Fates Stalker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

225-1308-2557-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-7934.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Federation Field Medic.
When Federation Field Medic dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Federation Field Medic enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2438-3413-4875.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Conspiracy, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1251-3259-7603.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that has base power 0.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-3259-7603.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Primo.
Resolve the Primo trigger, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the damage dealt.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Fractal token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4321-4636-5159.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a 4/4 artifact creature token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart named Mishra's Warform and a Food token.
When the Food and Mishra's Warform enters the battlefield, Mishra's Warform and Gonti's Aether Heart trigger twice each, causing you to get eight {E}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying eight {E} and exiling it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2174-3525-7069.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Tectonic Split
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Tectonic Split.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Repeat.

2741-2919-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2741-2919-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1976-2034-2363-5224.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1734-2921-6132.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3090-4050-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Repeat from step 2.

1497-2173-2324-5220.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Proper Burial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1850-1863-5412.description:
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-1863-5412.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

628-2511-6863--133.notablePrerequisites: Blue has a -1/-1 counter on it.
628-2511-6863--133.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the other Dinosaur.
When the Dinosaur dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to the -1/-1 counter it will gain from Blue.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.
628-2511-6863--133.notes: The chosen Dinosaur must not be a Human for the combo to work. Notably, this means you cannot use a creature with changeling for this combo.

2558-5687-5692-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Weapons Trainer, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-3499-6664.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control five or more Towns.
3259-3499-6664.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Wandering Minstrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

710-2961-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, False Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Danitha's power.
Repeat.

862-939-1636-4694.notablePrerequisites:
Soul Foundry does not have summoning sickness.
Crimson Kobolds exiled by Soul Foundry.
862-939-1636-4694.description:
Activate Soul Foundry by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Crimson Kobolds
When the Crimson Kobolds token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

413-1580-2018-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Reassembling Skeleton from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station abilities from steps 1 and 6, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-907-943.description:
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Selesnya Sanctuary.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Selesnya Sanctuary.
Repeat.
74-907-943.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other land except Selesnya Sanctuary instead.

7-435-708-2500-2931.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with a +1/+1 counter on them.
7-435-708-2500-2931.description:
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Myth Unbound until end of turn.
Cast Faceless One from the command zone by paying {0}.
Activate Auratog by sacrificing Faceless One.
Choose to return Faceless One to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 2.

2792-4790.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {6}.
2792-4790.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {6}.
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
If the up to seven lands can tap to produce at least {7}, this combo nets infinite mana.

2096-2584-2615.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, God-Pharaoh's Gift triggers, exiling Tree of Perdition from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is a 4/4 Zombie with haste.
When the Tree of Perdition token enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Tree of Perdition token by tapping it, swapping an opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Resolve the Pandemonium trigger, causing the Tree of Perdition token to deal damage equal to its power to the opponent whose life total was swapped.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

553-2856.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
553-2856.description:
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to gain 7 life and put Approach of the Second Sun into your library seventh from the top.
Cast Mystical Tutor by paying {U}, searching your library for Approach of the Second Sun and putting it on top of your library.
Draw Approach of the Second Sun from your library.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to win the game.

220-1640-4083.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter is indestructible.
220-1640-4083.description:
Deal damage to Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter and Repercussion trigger.
Resolve the Brash Taunter trigger, dealing damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Repercussion trigger, dealing damage to Brash Taunter instead of you due to Pariah's Shield.
Repeat from step 2.

914-2178-3379-5147.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
Thornbite Staff attached to Adun.
Adun does not have summoning sickness.
914-2178-3379-5147.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate five treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{R}{R}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, Adun triggers, untapping Adun.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Adun by paying {B}{R}{G} and tapping it, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1821-3698-3764-4875.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
When the Pincher enters the battlefield as a Phyrexian due to Conspiracy, Essence of Orthodoxy triggers, creating an Incubator artifact token.
When the Incubator enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Incubator.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

4067-4135-5042.notablePrerequisites:
Tablet of Compleation has at least five oil counters on it.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
4067-4135-5042.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Tablet of Compleation's third ability by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to draw two cards.
Activate Mind over Matter twice by discarding two cards, untapping Tablet of Compleation and the mana-producing permanent.
Repeat.

851-1409-2564-4231.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with another creature.
851-1409-2564-4231.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering its soulbond ability and Lonis.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating two Clue, two Food, and two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and any other creature.
Activate the two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2872-3525-4878.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Clever Conjurer.
Market Festival attached to a land you control.
Clever Conjurer does not have summoning sickness.
2872-3525-4878.description:
Activate the land with Market Festival attached, adding at least {1}.
Market Festival triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Repeat.

220-1640-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to you and a creature. The damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to Brash Taunter instead due to Pariah's Shield.
Brash Taunter triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to an applicable target.

1945-2232-2858-3273.description:
Pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice putting Chandra, Flamecaller onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Torch of Defiance to your hand.
+1 Chandra, Flamecaller creating 2 3/1 elementals with haste.
Then pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice once again, putting Chandra, Torch of Defiance onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Flamecaller to your hand.
+1 Chandra adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

937-3591-4695.description:
During your upkeep, activate Necropotence by paying 1 life, exiling the top card of your library face down.
Repeat step 1 until you have zero life.
Activate Magus of the Mirror by tapping and sacrificing it, exchanging your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
